content: आप्रच्छ् €6 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To bid adieu, bid farewell; आपृच्छस्व प्रियसखममुं तुङ्गमालिङ्ग्य शैलम् <ls>Me. 12</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 49</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 103</ls>; <ls>Māl. 7</ls>; <ls>Bk. 14. 63</ls>. .²2 To salute on receiving, but particularly parting with a visitor (साधो यामि इति वचनम्) .²3 To ask. .²4 To extol. Irregularly it is used in Parasmaipada also; <ab>cf.</ab> आपृच्छ पुत्रकृतकान् हरिणान् द्रुमांश्च <ls>Pratimā 5. 11</ls>.
